proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_signal_type×regime×sector = UP_TRI × Bull × Bank (20.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_signal_type×regime×sector = UP_TRI × Bull × Bank; recommended action: Pause new entries in signal_type=UP_TRI AND in sector=Bank until (a) Bank aggregate share drops below 30% via natural Day-6 exits, and (b) at least one matched cohort promotes to Tier M. If a hedge is available, hedge Bank sector exposure (e.g., short BANKNIFTY futures sized to ~50% of Bank notional) rather than adding new longs.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If regime flips from Bull to Bear or a Bank-sector shock hits (RBI surprise, NPA event, financial stress), 40% of the book is Bank-concentrated and 100% is directional-long with no validated cohort edge to lean on — drawdown would compound across cells simultaneously with no offsetting positions.

evidence: UP_TRI×Bull×Bank cell = 2/10 = 20.0% — at the 0.20 hard cell threshold
Bank sector aggregate = 4/10 = 40% across regimes (UP_TRI×Bull×Bank 2, BULL_PROXY×Choppy×Bank 1, UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank 1)
Matched Bull×UP_TRI cohort is Candidate-tier only (n=145) — unvalidated edge
All 9 concentration cells map to Candidate-tier cohorts — no validated edge anywhere in the book
Extends multi-week warn streak (20+ consecutive days) of directional-long monoculture on unvalidated cohorts
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.recommended_action: Pause new entries in signal_type=UP_TRI AND in sector=Bank until (a) Bank aggregate share drops below 30% via natural Day-6 exits, and (b) at least one matched cohort promotes to Tier M. If a hedge is available, hedge Bank sector exposure (e.g., short BANKNIFTY futures sized to ~50% of Bank notional) rather than adding new longs.
decision_metadata.tail_risk_scenario: If regime flips from Bull to Bear or a Bank-sector shock hits (RBI surprise, NPA event, financial stress), 40% of the book is Bank-concentrated and 100% is directional-long with no validated cohort edge to lean on — drawdown would compound across cells simultaneously with no offsetting positions.
decision_metadata.llm_rationale: UP_TRI×Bull×Bank cell hits the 0.20 cell threshold exactly at 20% (2/10), triggering the hard cell-concentration rule. Additionally, the book is 100% directional-long (UP_TRI 70% + BULL_PROXY 30%) and all concentrated cells match only Candidate-tier cohorts (Bull×UP_TRI n=145, Choppy×UP_TRI n=373, Bull×BULL_PROXY n=5) — unvalidated edge across the entire book. Extends a multi-week warn streak of directional-long monoculture on unvalidated cohorts.
